text:
maria: Quick idea 0 collapse left nav into three anchors (Projects, Model hub, Observability) and surface the rest via contextual flyouts. Make deep links canonical (full-path) so external links are stable. Thoughts?

sam: Sounds good. main worry is breadcrumb stability for copy/paste.

lina: Breadcrumbs should always show the logical path (Org > Project > Model > Versions) even if the sidebar is compacted. Keeps automation stable.

alex: Agree. Also standardize on full-path routes (no hashes). Use query params for stable view state, hashes only for ephemeral UI toggles.

maria: Example: `https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acme/projects/zephyr/models/zephyr-7b?panel=metrics` and ephemeral like `#inspector=open`.

ethan: A11y notes: keyboard focus order must follow logical headings, not visual collapsed groups. Flyouts need aria-live when opened and focus management.

sam: UX Q: clicking a subitem in a collapsed group  expand then navigate or navigate keeping group collapsed?

lina: Navigate directly (keep collapsed) to save vertical space, but briefly highlight parent group or show small toast "Found under Model hub" with `aria-live=polite`.

alex: Migration: support legacy hash routes for 6 months via a routing shim that maps `#/m/abc` patterns to canonical paths and logs occurrences.

maria: Good. Dev cost?

ethan: Low initially. Log unmatched legacy routes for 30d and set telemetry flag `legacy_route_handled=true` when shim fires.

prod-bot: deploy-preview published: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/compact-leftnav (preview/compact-leftnav) includes shim + breadcrumb tests.

sam: I'll run an a11y sweep tomorrow. Checklist: focus order, screenreader announcements, link text specificity, keyboard expand/collapse.

lina: Copy tweak: use "Model hub" instead of "Models" when compact. Breadcrumbs should use resource names not UI labels.

maria: Bookmark policy: prefer canonical path + stable query params (e.g., `?eval=123`); avoid serializing ephemeral panel state. Document supported query keys.

sam: When redirecting legacy -> canonical, call `focus()` on main heading and set `document.title` so screen reader users remain oriented.

maria: Next steps: 1) push preview to design + a11y 2) sam to run a11y pass 3) eng to add legacy route telemetry 4) product to publish query param contract. I'll post updated mocks soon. :sparkles:
